sources: https://www.facebook.com/91pines (page title and description only; no rates or posts readable without login)
Google Maps place panel '91 Pines Campground', 91 NE-91, Burwell, NE 68823 (read 2026-11-04)
summary: No operator website (Facebook page only, 349 followers, no rates readable); Google Maps 4.8 from 16 reviews with phone 308-214-1950 (stored 308-214-0198); no posted nightly rate anywhere I could read. RV Life $ tier (5.0 from 1 review; that review paid $20 in 9/2024). Imagery shows ~12 RVs on a gravel loop by a farmhouse off NE-91, pin on it; river beyond a treeline ~150 m north, not waterfront confirmed. Nothing changed.
flags: PRESENCE (drop candidate): no website of its own (stored website is the Facebook page; no other domain found), and Google Maps has only 16 reviews (4.8) - under the 25-review presence line. Price only via RV Life $ tier (1 review: 'stayed 9/2024 | price $20 USD a night ... Motorhome ... power 1 water yes sewer no'). No posted rate from the operator. By the presence rule (website + phone, or Google 25+ reviews + phone) this fails; I read it as a drop candidate unless AWH wants a thinly-documented small park kept.

FOR SALE? A search result shows a LoopNet commercial listing '45947 Highway 91, Burwell NE' described (in the search snippet only) as '22 Camper Sites & House', near Calamus Lake; LoopNet answered Access Denied so I could not read it or its date. If the campground is on the market its operation is uncertain.

PHONE: Google Maps gives (308) 214-1950; the entry has 308-214-0198 (which the inclusion evidence attributes to VisitNebraska, whose page sat behind a Cloudflare challenge and stayed unread). Neither confirmed on an operator page; call-check before relying on either.
LONG-STAY: imagery shows ~12 RVs parked close together on the loop with a farmhouse; I could not tell nightly vs seasonal occupancy, and no review describes residents. Unassessed rather than passed.
PIN OK: stored 41.75664,-99.26966 sits on the RV cluster (Google's point 41.7575,-99.2691 is the farmhouse ~100 m NE).
